mentions.name: Organizer
mentions.description: Organizer is an open-source tool for organizing personal stuff, which can also double as a photo album and private log, with data stored locally. It is complete and does what the author wanted it to.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://www.useorganizer.com/ helps you organize stuff primarily but can also double as photo album and private log. Open source and local storage. Not so much working on. It is complete and does what I wanted it to.
